_note: Opt-out URLs and procedures change often. If a link 404s, search '<broker> opt out' and update this file. 'search_url' placeholders: {first} {last} {city} {state} {state_full} (URL-encoded).

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.steps: Find your listing, copy its URL, paste it into the opt-out form with an email address, then click the confirmation link emailed to you.

brokers.name: Whitepages
brokers.steps: Paste your listing URL, confirm it's you, and complete the phone verification call (they read you a code).

brokers.name: PeopleConnect (Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search, ZabaSearch)
brokers.steps: Log in with your email, verify it, search for your record, and suppress it. One suppression covers all PeopleConnect brands.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
brokers.steps: Search your name and state, select your record, enter an email, then click the verification link.

brokers.name: PeopleLooker (BeenVerified network)
brokers.steps: Same flow as BeenVerified: search, select your record, verify by email.

brokers.name: PeopleFinders
brokers.steps: Search for your record, select it, and submit the opt-out; confirm by email.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch
brokers.steps: Enter your email, confirm the link, find your record, and click 'Remove my record'.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
brokers.steps: Enter your email, confirm the link, locate your record, and click 'Remove this record'.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.steps: Find your profile URL, submit it on the privacy control page, and verify by email/phone.

brokers.name: MyLife
brokers.steps: Send a deletion request by email, or use the CCPA form if you're a California resident.

brokers.name: PeekYou
brokers.steps: Paste your profile URL and submit the form; confirm by email.

brokers.name: USPhoneBook
brokers.steps: Search your name, select your record, and submit with an email for confirmation.

brokers.name: That's Them
brokers.steps: Fill out the opt-out form with the exact details shown on your listing.

brokers.name: Nuwber
brokers.steps: Paste your profile URL, enter an email, and click the confirmation link.

brokers.name: ClustrMaps
brokers.steps: Find your record and submit it on the opt-out page.

brokers.name: SearchPeopleFree
brokers.steps: Enter your email, confirm, then select and remove your record.

brokers.name: Advanced Background Checks
brokers.steps: Enter your email, confirm, then locate and remove your record.

brokers.name: CyberBackgroundChecks
brokers.steps: Enter your email, confirm, then locate and remove your record.

brokers.name: PeopleSearchNow
brokers.steps: Locate your record and submit the opt-out form.

brokers.name: CheckPeople
brokers.steps: Search for your record, select it, and verify by email.

brokers.name: Acxiom (marketing data)
brokers.steps: Marketing broker with no public search. Submit the opt-out form for each name/address/email you use.

brokers.name: LexisNexis
brokers.steps: No public search. Submit the opt-out form; you may need to provide ID or proof of a qualifying reason.
